unit: npmx library address audit + config wrappers
method: Built the vendored upstream npmx v1.0.1 (third-party/upstream/npmx/drivers/src + backends, -DNPM1300, cortex-m55 hard-float -O2) to labeled objects, then matched the IAR-built stock library (carved 0x55d000-0x561000) function-by-function by structural evidence: getters by (element-shift, post-shift offset) e.g. return p_pm+offset+idx*2^shift; setters/readers by npm1300 register-address constants and backend call direction (register_write @0x55fc2c vs register_read @0x55fc38). Stock is IAR so not byte-identical to the gcc upstream; matching is on structure + register constants + call graph, cross-checked against the sources.json rename map.
corrections_vs_zip_map: 0x55ee8c is npmx_vbusin_get (zip map wrongly labeled it vbusin_task_trigger)
